_comment: Friendly names for the boxes, so the tools read `vmctl start head`
instead of `vmctl start i-0428c395787bc3ca0`. Two of the instances
share the Name tag 'ray-sculptor-head', which is why an alias file
exists at all -- resolution by tag was ambiguous.
Add a line when you create a box; nothing here is discovered.

notes.i-0428c395787bc3ca0: c8g.24xlarge, 96 vCPU. THE working box: carries the repo, the 4.5GB vultr_ingress_latencies_by_dst.csv, the eods25 results and harvested figures. Has ELASTIC IP 107.22.173.189, so its address survives stop/start (and the Apache dash at http://107.22.173.189/ keeps working). The EIP bills ~$0.005/hr (~$3.60/mo) while the box is stopped -- that is the price of the stable address, and it is worth it.
notes.i-09a6ff2823b0bb304: m7g.4xlarge, 16 vCPU / 64 GB. The original small head. Too small for actual-25+ drivers (OOM), fine for cheap smoke work.
notes.i-04d7439fa93efaf2a: c8g.24xlarge, 200 GB disk, untagged (no project=sculptor tag -- teardown.sh will NOT see it). Was the preflight32 box.
